name: Harbour
author: Theme Gallery
description: Still water at dusk, with a soft glow on the horizon
about:
# Harbour

The first community theme, here so the shelf is never empty and so creators have a file to read.

Slate-blue surfaces a few shades apart, a lantern-amber accent, and a gradient that runs from the page into a faint wash of the accent.

- Works in light and dark
- Shows a gradient background made of palette names, so one background serves both modes
